_what: A room brought onto the street by tools/import-room.py from an artifact somebody built with their own AI. Everything here is read off that artifact's FOR THE STREET comment or measured from the room as it renders; nothing is typed. check-contrast.py holds the pairs, check-jukebox.py checks the tracks, and re-importing replaces this file whole.
title: Spaceholder Saloon
description: A saloon for spaceholding, venting, solidarity and straight up bitchin' on spoon fumes, lit by oil lamps on the mantle.
name: Norah
light: The old oil lamps on the mantle above the fireplace.
words: Norah wrote the opening paragraph and the menu board line; Claude drafted the line about the light from Norah's description, plus the headings, the menu items and their descriptions, the seat lines, the hooks by the door and the credits, all for Norah to change.
built_with: Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic

pairs.where: p.ss-board-says “Spaceholder Saloon only serves up patience, ”
p “Closest to the fire. Rock as much or as litt”
